row_rules.text_keys: non-empty strings without leading or trailing whitespace
row_rules.weights: finite nonnegative sums and squared-weight sums
row_rules.hashes: lowercase SHA-256; input_sha256 and config_sha256 each constant across the file
row_rules.config_sha256_authority: N3 producer/MC configuration, bound by acceptance_qa.json
row_rules.input_sha256_authority: N3 input inventory, bound by acceptance_qa.json

matrix_rules.flattening: mass_bin * P + phi_bin on both axes
matrix_rules.coverage: exactly (M*P)^2 explicit rows per key and orientation, including zero migrations and invalid true cells
matrix_rules.axes: true and reconstructed partitions equal; both orientations share partitions; indices contiguous from zero
matrix_rules.source_period: one pooled matrix per beam_group and orientation, reused for covered source periods
matrix_rules.generated_values: n_generated_true, sumw_generated_true, sumw2_generated_true repeat identically within each true-cell block
matrix_rules.releasable: every true-cell block in both orientations has validity_mask=valid

azimuth.coverage: contiguous bins, no gaps, overlaps or implicit wrap

mass_partition.partition: M equal-width bins spanning the observable range (physical_mass_edges)

normalization.inefficiency: 1 - sum_j pj is lost-event inefficiency; never renormalize columns
normalization.undefined_invalid_block: Keep all raw finite count/weight diagnostics and Cartesian rows; when G=0 or G2=0, response_probability=0 and response_stat_uncertainty=0; covariance blocks zero; invalid masks remain nonreleasable

covariance.requirements: finite, symmetric, positive semidefinite within covariance_eigenvalue_absolute_tolerance; materially negative variance or eigenvalue rejects N3

tolerances.overrides: No CLI override may weaken canonical approved limits

change_policy: Any field, equation, enum, coverage rule or tolerance change requires new schema version, approval ID, and joint review
